Detailed ecological clusters (porous white calcareous growth, muted olive ribbons) around support attachments, quiet empty water between focal groups. No masonry, no teeth, no skull piles, no sunlit sea surface, no HUD, text, arrows, borders or panel divisions. Wide 16:9 composition. A connected playable environment concept, not a generic landscape. Keep jump/footing silhouettes clear; foreground never covers road top. Original IP, no insect knight, horns, sword or nail.
